_comment: Models shown by /ar.html. Each entry: id (URL ?m=), glb (required, metres, Y-up), usdz (optional - iOS Quick Look uses it directly, otherwise model-viewer converts the GLB on the fly), placement floor|wall, scale fixed (life-size) | auto. See the repo README for the scan-to-web pipeline.

caption.zh: 溫哥華史丹利公園布羅克頓角的圖騰柱，是加拿大最多人參觀的景點之一。這是 5.6 公尺高的示意模型：熊、人像、渡鴉與雷鳥四層疊起。真正的掃描完成後會換成實物。
caption.en: The totem poles at Brockton Point in Vancouver's Stanley Park are among the most visited sights in Canada. This is a 5.6 m stylised stand-in with four stacked figures: bear, human, raven and thunderbird. It will be replaced by a real scan.

models.credit: Stylised model built in Blender 4.5 on GitHub Actions - not a scan

caption.zh: 溫哥華英吉利灣海濱的因紐特石堆（Inukshuk），1986 年世博會後由西北地區贈予溫哥華，是 2010 冬奧會標誌的原型。這是 6 公尺高的示意模型，以 USDZ 檔放進 scans/ 由 GitHub Actions 自動轉檔登記。真正的掃描完成後會換成實物。
caption.en: The Inukshuk on the English Bay seawall in Vancouver, a gift from the Northwest Territories after Expo 86 and the inspiration for the 2010 Winter Olympics emblem. This is a 6 m stylised stand-in that was dropped into scans/ as a USDZ and converted and registered by GitHub Actions. It will be replaced by a real scan.

models.credit: Stylised stand-in built in Blender 4.5 and pushed through scans/ as a Y-up USDZ - not a scan

title.zh: 卡美哈梅哈一世國王像

caption.zh: 夏威夷王國第一任國王卡美哈梅哈一世的雕像，立在檀香山阿里伊奧拉尼宮前，是歐胡島市區觀光的一站。原作由湯瑪斯·古爾德於 1880 年設計：金色羽毛披風、羽毛頭盔與腰帶，左手握矛，右手高舉。這是依原作造型做的示意模型，比例為約略值。真正的掃描完成後會換成實物。
caption.en: King Kamehameha I, first king of the Hawaiian Kingdom, stands in front of Aliʻiōlani Hale in Honolulu, a stop on the Oahu city tour. Thomas Gould's 1880 design gives him a gilded feather cloak, helmet and sash, a spear in his left hand and his right arm raised. This is a stylised stand-in with approximate proportions. It will be replaced by a real scan.

label.zh: 夏威夷歐胡島＋茂宜島＋火山島 6 日遊（7373）
label.en: Hawaii: Oahu, Maui and Big Island 6-day tour (7373)

models.credit: Stylised model of Thomas Gould's 1880 design (public domain), built in Blender 4.5 on GitHub Actions - not a scan

caption.zh: 溫哥華煤氣鎮的蒸汽鐘，每十五分鐘用蒸汽吹響汽笛報時。這是實際大小約 4.7 公尺的示意模型。
caption.en: Vancouver's Gastown steam clock whistles the quarter hours on steam. A life-size stand-in, about 4.7 m tall.

models.credit: Stylised model built in Blender 4.5 on GitHub Actions - not a scan

caption.zh: 加拿大國家公園在觀景點擺放的紅色木椅，露易絲湖等地都有。實際大小的一對，可以放在客廳裡坐坐看。
caption.en: Parks Canada sets red Adirondack chairs at viewpoints, Lake Louise among them. A life-size pair to put in your living room.

models.credit: Stylised model built in Blender 4.5 on GitHub Actions - not a scan

caption.zh: 原高 146.6 公尺、底邊 230 公尺，這裡縮成 1:150，約 1 公尺高，放在桌上或地上剛好。
caption.en: 146.6 m tall and 230 m along each side in real life, shown here at 1:150 so it is about 1 m tall on your table or floor.

label.en: Egypt cruise and ancient wonders, 12 days (7564)

models.credit: Stylised model built in Blender 4.5 on GitHub Actions - not a scan

caption.zh: 約 56 公尺高、傾斜約 4 度的鐘樓，這裡縮成 1:30，大約和人一樣高。
caption.en: The 56 m bell tower that leans about 4 degrees, here at 1:30 so it stands about as tall as a person.

models.credit: Stylised model built in Blender 4.5 on GitHub Actions - not a scan

caption.zh: 天壇祈年殿：三層藍色琉璃瓦圓頂，坐在三層漢白玉台基上。殿本身縮成 1:20；台基縮得更多，才放得進房間。
caption.en: The Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests: three blue-tiled roofs on a three-tier marble terrace. The hall is at 1:20; the terrace is cut down further so it fits a room.

caption.zh: 示範模型：一座 2.4 公尺高的石灰岩基座與大理石半身像。真正的景點掃描完成後，只要把掃描檔放進 scans/，GitHub Actions 會自動轉檔並登記，就會在這裡出現。
caption.en: Demo model: a 2.4 m limestone pedestal with a marble bust. Once a real landmark is scanned, drop the scan into scans/ and register it in index.json and it appears here.

models.credit: Procedural demo built in Blender 4.5 - stand-in for an iPhone Object Capture scan
